sources.title: Office of Citizenship and Migration Affairs (PMLP), official English page -- residence permit durations by category: self-employed persons up to 1 year; individual merchants up to 5 years

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Latvia). STATUS: DRAFT, THIN SOURCING -- the category's existence and 1-year duration are tier-1, but no independently-confirmed procedural detail (minimum income, registration process specifics) beyond the bare category listing was found in this pass. The same PMLP page lists a separate 'individual merchant' (individuālais komersants) category valid up to 5 years, which may be a more substantial/higher-bar variant of self-employment -- not modeled as a separate file here since no distinguishing conditions between the two were independently confirmed, disclosed as an open question rather than guessed at.
